Tejashwi Yadav claims PM cancelled Bihar visit due to fear of BJP loss

RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav claimed that Prime Minister Narendra Modi cancelled his scheduled visit to Bihar. Yadav stated the cancellation was due to the Prime Minister's realization that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) would lose the Bankipur by-election. This statement was reported by multiple centrist outlets.
